Facing down, "nothing at 2,8". So the notice board isn't interactable from my tile either. 

I'm genuinely stuck at (2,7) and cannot move. Let me reconsider the possibility that the game engine requires the player to move first, or that I'm a "ghost" companion. 

Let me try one experiment: what if movement works but only registers when I hold for exactly the right frame? Let me try holding two directions or check if maybe the game is paused waiting for a "start" press. Let me try pressing KeyC (craft) to see if any menu opens.
